title: Lake_of_Rage
lead_summary:
The Lake of Rage can be accessed from Route 43.
There is a cabin where the player can use the bed to heal its party.
There is an icy rock which Colress is inspecting and is looking for a key. It will react to the Light Stone and the Dark Stone, then freeze the lake and prevent the player to exit until Kyurem has been defeated or captured. Touching the Icy rock again will return the lake back to normal
